name: Workspace files
description: Create local documents as attachments from a private OpenClaw chat command. This PC is Windows 11 Pro, an Intel Core i9-14900F (24 cores, 32 threads), 64 GB DDR5-5600, and an RTX 4070 with 12 GB (driver 610.60). About 1.5 TB is free on the fast NVMe. This plugin does not use the GPU.
